requirements.title: Prepared, not surprised
requirements.implementation: One calm Today view offers the next eligible meeting, last confirmed discussion, outstanding commitments, key unknowns and source dates. Pre-meeting briefs use only authorized context; private-to-me does not imply shareable-to-the-room. Absent calendar access is a clear manual route, not a blank spinner.
requirements.acceptance: A user finds the relevant last commitment within two deliberate interactions on the defined fixture; wrong-account, guest and expired-source tests deny disclosure.

requirements.title: Human notes remain the user’s work
requirements.implementation: Support lightweight human-authored notes and explicit important-moment markers during a meeting. Keep raw human notes, generated enhancements and accepted corrections as distinct revisions. Enhancements are previewed and can be accepted by block; re-run never overwrites newer edits. A moment marker is not permission to retain an audio clip. Persist permitted human notes only in the chosen knowledge environment, never telemetry.
requirements.acceptance: Typing while a partial transcript arrives, enhancement returns late, storage fails or another editor changes a block does not lose human text. The original and accepted revision remain explainable; unretained source intervals are not fabricated quotations.

requirements.title: Useful, quiet live assistance
requirements.implementation: Provide Catch me up, What should I ask?, Explain this term and commitments-so-far in a small optional in-meeting panel. Tie each answer to current authorized interval/source freshness. A coalesced foreground request outranks background analysis. Do not trigger models on every transcript token; no unsolicited speech, focus grabbing or automatic sending.
requirements.acceptance: After a topic change, obsolete suggestions expire without erasing pinned human notes. Verify source intervals, catch-up coverage, request count, latency and no duplicate audio session under real capture.

requirements.title: Trusted follow-through, not a wall of prose
requirements.implementation: Turn an approved summary into a short review inbox: decision, action, owner, due date, evidence and unresolved fields. Draft follow-ups and CRM updates as separate proposals. Show exact destination/object and field diff before consequential commit; resolve unknown outcomes with readback. Drafting, saving, sharing and sending are distinct permissions.
requirements.acceptance: One supported CRM/task/email route is demonstrated with exact-payload approval, idempotency, stale edit conflict and remote object receipt. No universal connector claims or unauthorized automatic sync.

requirements.title: A powerful notebook with fewer settings
requirements.implementation: Today, meeting workspace, search and review should be reachable without a vendor/model menu. Preserve the four Settings destinations and all old-key dispositions. Show recovery and effective policy in context. Include back-to-back meeting handover, clean empty states, narrow windows, keyboard/screen-reader flow and native conventions.
requirements.acceptance: Run the existing nontechnical task study plus back-to-back and permission-denied cases; measure unassisted success, mistakes and time rather than counting screenshots.

requirements.title: Vocabulary and template quality without false certainty
requirements.implementation: Use reviewed, scoped vocabulary only on a transport that supports it and qualifies for privacy. It biases recognition; it cannot substitute a term against evidence. Keep all nine existing role-specific recaps and support reviewed alternate summaries from the same authorized record without overwriting original or human-accepted content.
requirements.acceptance: Held-out names/amounts/negations include plausible-but-wrong glossary matches. Compare critical errors and corrections by language, not just aggregate WER; explicitly unavailable provider features do not get invented flags.

requirements.title: Capture choices with truthful recovery
requirements.implementation: Qualify live command, desktop meeting, supported bot/media and authorized audio/transcript import independently. Capture is neither covert nor universal. Use one occurrence source lease. Safe imports are format/size/sniff constrained, preserve timezone/speaker uncertainty and never silently upload a user-selected local-only file.
requirements.acceptance: Handover from a failed source is explicit and gap-aware, not a second hidden recorder. Crash/reboot cannot resume an expired recording authority. Imported material cannot arm desktop actions or bypass a selected retention profile.

requirements.title: A real enterprise entitlement and trust plane
requirements.implementation: Resolve the source export’s separate legacy license and Operator capability paths. Document issuance, seat/device ownership, offline lease, authority, expiry, revocation and bootstrap. Shared funding is not shared access. Existing legitimate data access/recovery remains possible under a spending outage.
requirements.acceptance: Wrong tenant, dev trust key, copied lease, concurrency race and revoked seat fail appropriate capability boundaries. No unbounded paid relay or accidental second license authority.

requirements.title: No silent loss or misleading success
requirements.implementation: Every save, command, source handover, skill and external write exposes accepted/attempted/committed/verified/unknown accurately. Use revision-aware writes, safe reconciliation and finite retries. Stored-but-indexing is not failed; queued is not committed; a model response is not an object receipt.
requirements.acceptance: Inject failures between commit, receipt and projection. No duplicate side effects, missing summaries painted complete, false native save, swallowed error or resurrected revoked/deleted record.

requirements.title: Animated identity, bounded cost
requirements.implementation: ARMED is only an animated monochrome solving orb on a transparent host, faithful to Libraries.dev. Caption, bar and voice glow appear only with the appropriate active surface. Local animation never represents network/model activity. Honor reduced motion, explicit pause and resource policies; no desktop-wide invisible input region.
requirements.acceptance: Record time-separated frames plus original algorithm/preset lineage; test phase continuity, hide/show, DPR, focus, draft retention, energy policy and real native hit-testing. Pausing the visual does not silently stop or start microphone capture.

requirements.title: Portability and control over knowledge
requirements.implementation: Provide authenticated exports of permitted approved notes/actions with schema, sources, revisions and ownership. Sharing defaults to explicit principals rather than anyone with a link. Revoke links/read paths promptly. Dust edits canonical objects, not generated markdown. Exports do not quietly add unretained transcripts or excluded voiceprints.
requirements.acceptance: Round-trip permitted exports, valid subset imports, CSV/HTML injection tests, redacted fields, wrong-audience links and rights workflows. Expired/deleted links cannot reveal titles/counts or cached content.

requirements.title: Evidence-based competitive and operational qualification
requirements.implementation: Compare the same consented tasks, languages, hardware/network and privacy scope against legitimate available competitor trials. Score completion, critical factual errors, user editing burden, time-to-useful-result, accessibility, total work/cost and resource footprint. Separate vendor claims, source review, simulated UX and executed product evidence. No official affiliation, infallibility or superiority claim is inferred from feature count.
requirements.acceptance: Pre-register supported slices and report failures/abstentions/uncertainty, no cherry-picked clips or changed denominators. Require final signed Windows and native Mac QA receipts, actual backend and mirror-safe release facts before a public claim.

adds_to: 55 baseline M2 requirements; no baseline IDs removed
scope: Required qualifications of the requested meeting-copilot upgrade; every row maps to existing work, not an unrelated new platform.
